subject: Can camera days be a covariate for detection in N-mixture model?

messages.author: 4d68799d862fc72d
messages.subject: Can camera days be a covariate for detection in N-mixture model?
parts:
Hi all,

I have a question about camera days or camera effort. Could I take it as a covariate for detection probability in N-mixture model?
If that the same as occupancy model, it will automatically account for sampling effort differences? That is saying if the camera did not take photos, this lack of effort gets included automatically as  undetected?

Thanks in advance.

Wenhong

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Can camera days be a covariate for detection in N-mixture model?
parts:
hi Wenhong,

 It would be ok to do this but it might be better to have the sample occasion == 1 day, and then y[I,j] = count of individuals at trap I and occasion j. Then effort is implicitly accounted for by the number of replicates.

regards
andy
